i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B, \n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                sum += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n            C[i * N + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t N = 512;\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n    }\n    std::vector<double> A(N * N), B(N * N), C(N * N);\n    initMatrix(A, N);\n    initMatrix(B, N);\n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, N);\n    print_results(C, \"MatrixC\");\n    return 0;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/run/llm-eval/state/tmp/opencode/orig/matmul_orig.cpp","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"run/llm-eval/state/tmp/opencode/orig/matmul_orig.cpp","time":{"start":1792951602292,"end":1792951602324}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1743e4c27001BEx6DimTv2zjD1","sessionID":"ses_e8bc343dcffevuObijhyd5Bw2P","messageID":"msg_1743e370b001W43n650qba3IP6"}}
